text:
The neighbor would most likely recover for negligence, because the mechanic breached a duty of reasonable care by allowing gasoline and oil residue to accumulate and ignite, and the smoke discoloration was a foreseeable result of that negligence. Trespass is less apt because the intrusion was smoke/particulate rather than a physical object, though some courts treat airborne particulates as trespassory. I would choose negligence over trespass.

CONFIDENCE: 70
